title: Uncurried normalization of the integral Hom comparison
statement: Let D, ℓ, E, X and n be as in the integral Hom reduction comparison normalization statement. Let a be a normalized TensorPresentation and m a ReductionPresentation of a at n. For all derived inputs K,L, apply the inverse Hom equivalence of the target TensorPresentation adjunction at the canonical comparison integralHomReductionComparison. The resulting map equals the composite m.mu.inv at (K, Hom(K,L)) followed by the derived reduction of the source adjunction counit at (K,L).

source.place: Tags 06YY and 08J7, normalization of the evaluation transpose on K-flat representatives.

proof.text: Resolve K and L by flat-term K-flat representatives and the Hom target by a K-injective complex. The cochain tensor model rigidity comparison identifies both normalized tensor presentations with the signed total tensor. On homogeneous sections, the evaluation sign cancels the Koszul exchange, while the scalar unit sends x to 1 tensor x. The two normalization equations therefore give the same uncurried map after applying the target adjunction.

Use naturality of the representative comparisons and the localization universal property to transport the representative equality to arbitrary K and L. The displayed composite is exactly the uncurried form of the ReductionPresentation comparison by its definition.

lean.statement:
theorem integralHomComparison_uncurry_eq
    (D : FiniteFieldDatum.{d}) (l : ℕ) [Fact l.Prime] (hl : l ≠ D.p)
    (E : Type u) [Field E] [Algebra (Padic l) E] [FiniteDimensional (Padic l) E]
    (X : AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.{u}) (n : ℕ)
    (a : IntegralHom.TensorPresentation.{u, u} X
      (completedIntegralCommRingSheaf l E X D hl))
    (m : IntegralHom.ReductionPresentation l E X D hl a n)
    (K L : completedIntegralDerivedCategory l E X D hl) :
    ((m.target.adjunction
      ((integralDerivedReduction l E X D hl n).obj K)).homEquiv _ _).symm
      (integralHomReductionComparison D l hl E X n K L) =
      m.mu.inv.app
          (K,
            (homReductionHom (completedIntegralCommRingSheaf l E X D hl)).obj (op K, L)) ≫
        (integralDerivedReduction l E X D hl n).map
          ((a.adjunction K).counit.app L)
